tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// 'phags pa yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo bzhugs so/// /

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ārya bi pu le pra be sha ma hā sū tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo chen po/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das 'dam bu'i khrod na/ gzings pa'i 'dug gnas na bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo yangs pa'i grong khyer ga la bar 'dong ngo*/ btsun pa de ltar bgyi'o zhes gsol nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das yul li bri dzar rgyu zhing gshegs te/ yangs pa'i grong khyer du byon nas/ yangs pa'i grong khyer gyi a mra bsrung ba'i tshal na bzhugs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bol bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo yangs pa'i grong khyer du song la phyin nas sgo'i them pa la rkang pa zhog ste/ gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag dang*/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smros shig /bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba can gyis bka' bstsal to// sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa/ rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsams pa/ dgra bcom pa thams cad kyi bsams pa/ slob pa thams cad kyi bsams pa/ nyan thos thams cad kyi bsams pa/ bden pa'i tshig dang ldan pa thams cad kyi bsams pa/ chos kyi bsams pa/ tshangs pa'i bsams pa/ tshangs pa so so'i bsams pa/ 'dod pa'i dbang phyug gi bsams pa/ dbang po'i bsams pa/ lha'i bsams pa/ lha ma yin gyi dbang po'i bsams pa/ lha ma yin thams cad kyi bsams pa/ lha ma yin gyi mngag gzhug pa'i bsams pa/ 'byung po thams cad kyi bsams pa/ bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba can gyis bka' stsal pa/ muñtsa ta/ muñtsa ta/ ma 'dug cig yams kyi nad rnam par zhi bar gyur cig

/nirgatstsha ta/ nirgatstsha ta/ nirgatstsha ta/ nirgatstsha ta/ sangs rgyas lha chen po/ lha'i yang lha/ lha'i bla ma gshegs shing*/ dbang po dang bcas pa'i lha rnams dang*/ tshangs pa dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ dbang bdag dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ skye dgu'i bdag po dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi po dag kyang 'ong*/ lha 'bum phrag du ma dag dang*/ lha ma yin gyi dbang po rnams dang*/ lha ma yin 'bum phrag du ma dag kyang 'ong*/ bcom ldan 'das la mngon par dad pa'i 'byung po 'bum phrag du ma dag kyang sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir 'ongs te/ de dag khyed rnams la gnod pa chen po byed par 'gyur du 'ong gis/ nirgatstsha ta/ nirgatstsha ta/ nirgatstsha ta/ nirgatstsha ta/ myur du byer cig /khyed cag las gang sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa de dag ni phung bar gyur cig /gang dag byams pa'i sems dang ldan zhing nyes par mi 'dod la/ srung bar 'jug par 'dod pa de dag ni 'khod cig /lus la yang 'jug par gyis shig /sangs rgyas 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba can gyis bka' stsal pa/ su mu su mu su mu su mu/ su mu ru/ su mu ru/ su mu ru/ su mu ru/ su mu ru/ su mu ru/ su mu ru/ su mu ru/ mu ru/ mu ru/ mu ru/ mu ru/ mu ru/ mu ru/ mu ru/ mu ru/ mu ru/ mi ri/ mi ri/ mi ri/ mi ri/ mi ri mi ri/ mi ri mi ri/ mi ri mu ru/ mi ri mu ru/ ri mi/ mu ru ri mi/ mu ru ri mi/ mu ru ri mi/ mu ru ri mi/ mu ru ri mi/ mu ru ri mi/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mi rū ri ti/ ri ri ri ri ri ri/ rī rī rī rī rī rī/ ti mi ri mi ri mi ri mi ri mi ri mi ri mi ri mi ri ti ha si mi ri ti/ mī ri ti/ mi ti/ si si si mī/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka ra ta/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka ra tsa/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/

kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka ro tī ti/ ku ri sho kaṃ ka ra/ kaṃ ka ri shi/ ri ri ri ri ri ri/ ti ri te phu swā/ ri phu ri phu/ ri phu ri phu/ ri phu ri phu/ ri phu ri phu/ nā thā/ nā nā thā thā/ ri phu ri phu/ nā thā thā/ nirgatstsha ta/ ri phu ri phu/ nirgatstsha ta/ pā la ya ta/ ri phu ri phu/ pā la ya ta/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba can/ sems can thams cad la phan par lhag par dgongs pa dang ldan pa/ byams pa la gnas pa/ thugs rje dang ldan pa/ dga' ba la gnas pa/ btang snyoms la gnas pa gshegs kyi/ kyi phraṃ na nirgatstsha ta swā hā/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi mchog dang chos nyid kyis/ lha thams cad dang 'byung po thams cad la bka' stsal pa'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag ni grub pa'o// tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag ni grub pa'o// gang la ser sna rnam chags pa// rnam 'joms dri ma med mdzad cing*// thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// 'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams// thar pa'i lam du 'dzud mdzad cing*// chos rnams thams cad ston pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// ston pa 'jug pa rnams kyi rten// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gang gis bde ba mnga' mdzad des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yi// thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun// bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// gang zhig 'khor bar 'khor ba yi// sems can kun gyi rten gyur cing*// gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// gang zhig chos kun mngon sum gyur// gtsang zhing bslu ba mi mnga' la// gsung gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pa// phun sum tshogs don 'byor gyur cing*// don grub tshogs kyang grub pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// gang zhig skyes pa'i sa rnams ni// nags tshal bcangs par rab g.yos shing*// sems can thams cad rab dga' des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/

byang chub snying por gshegs pa na// sa bdag rnam drug g.yos gyur cing*// bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na// 'phags pa'i bden pa rnam gsung ba// thub pa'i snyan pa'i gang byung des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed// thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing*// tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad// brgya byin lhar bcas bde legs dang*// 'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni// khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang*// mi rnams kyi ni bsams pa yis// khyed rnams don 'dod gang yin pa// don de de ring grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /khyed cag lam 'gro bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i dgung la bde legs shing*// khyed cag kun du bde legs shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /sangs rgyas lha rnams stong dag gis// yongs su bskor te gshegs mdzad kyis// sdang sems ldan pa rnam byer cig /snying rje'i bdag nyid can rnams 'khod// sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas rnams dang*// dgra bcom slob pa'i bden tshig gis// 'jig rten mi phan byed pa rnams// grong khyer 'dir ni stong gyur cig /sems can kun dang srog chags kun// 'byung po kun dang khyed cag kun// bde ba 'ba' zhig ldan gyur cig /thams cad nad rnams med par shog /kun gyis bzang rnams mthong gyur cig /gang yang sdig par ma gyur cig /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur te// sa dang bar snang dag na gnas pa rnams// skye dgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed shog /nyin dang mtshan du chos kyang spyod gyur cig

/de skad ces bka' bstsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos/ btsun pa de bzhin bgyi'o zhes gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan nas/ yangs pa'i grong khyer du song ste/ sgo'i them pa la rkang pa bzhag nas/ gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag dang*/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag kyang smras so// bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba can gyis bka' bstsal to// sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa/ rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsam pa/ dgra bcom pa thams cad kyi bsam pa/ slob pa thams cad kyi bsam pa/ nyan thos thams cad kyi bsam pa/ bden pa'i tshig dang ldan pa thams cad kyi bsam pa/ chos kyi bsam pa/ tshangs pa'i bsam pa/ tshangs pa so so'i bsams pa/ 'dod pa'i dbang phyug gi bsam pa/ dbang po'i bsam pa/ lha yi bsam pa/ lha ma yin gyi dbang po'i bsam pa/ lha ma yin thams cad kyi bsam pa/ lha ma yin gyi mngag gzhug pa'i bsam pa/ 'byung po thams cad kyi bsam pa/ bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba can gyis bka' stsal to// muñtsa ta/ muñtsa ta/ yams nad thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /nirgatstsha ta/ nirgatstsha ta/ nirgatstsha ta/ nirgatstsha ta/ sangs rgyas lha chen po lha'i yang lha/ lha'i bla ma gshegs shing dbang po dang bcas pa'i lha rnams dang*/ tshangs pa dang bcas pa dang*/ dbang bdag dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ skye dgu'i bdag po dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ 'jig rten skyong bzhi po dag kyang 'ong*/ lha stong phrag du ma dag dang*/ lha ma yin gyi dbang po rnams sam/ lha ma yin stong phrag du ma dag kyang 'ong*/ bcom ldan 'das la mngon par dad pa'i 'byung po brgya stong mang po dag kyang sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir 'ong ste/ de dag khyed la gnod pa chen po byed par 'gyur gyis/ nirgatstsha ta/ nirgatstsha ta/ nirgatstsha ta/ nirgatstsha ta/ myur du byer cig /khyed cag las gang dag sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa de dag ni phung bar gyur cig

gtsang zhing bslu ba mi mnga' la// gsung gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pa// phun sum tshogs don 'byor gyur cing*// don grub tshogs kyang grub pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// gang zhig skyes pa'i sa rnams ni// nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yos shing*// sems can thams cad rab dga' des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ byang chub snying por gshegs pa na// sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur cing*// bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na// 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsung ba// thub pa'i snyan pa gang gyur des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed// thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing*// tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad// brgya byin lhar bcas bde legs dang*// 'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni// khyed la rtag tu brin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang*// lha rnams kyi ni bsam pa yis// khyed kyi don 'dod gang yin pa// don de de ring 'grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /khyed cag lam 'gro bde legs shog /phyir ldog dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i dgung la'ang bde legs shing*// khyed cag rtag tu bde legs shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /sangs rgyas lha rnams stong dag gis// yongs su bskor te gshegs mdzad cing*// sdang sems ldan pa rnams byer cig /snying rje'i bdag nyid can rnams 'khod// sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas rnams dang*// dgra bcom slob pa'i bden tshig gis// 'jig rten mi phan byed pa rnams// grong khyer 'dir ni stong gyur cig

/sems can kun dang srog chags kun// 'byung po kun dang khyed cag kun// bde ba 'ba' zhig ldan gyur cig /thams cad nad rnams med par shog /kun gyis bzang rnams mthong gyur cig /gang yang sdig par ma gyur cig /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur te/ sa dang bar snang dag la gnas pa rnams// skye dgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed shog /nyin dang mtshan du chos kyang spyod gyur cig /'phags pa yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo rdzogs so/// /rgya gar gyi mkhan po su rend+ra bo dhi dang*/ zhu chen gyi lotstsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ gtan la phab pa'o/// /
